description: Main action paired with a menu of alternative actions.

howToUse: Use it when one action is the usual one and a few variants of it are occasional: "Save" with "Save as draft" and "Save and close".
List the variants in `options`; the main side runs `defaultOptionId`, or the first enabled option.
Keep `loading` on while the action runs, as in Button.
alternatives: The options are equally common: Menu, or separate buttons.
Choosing a value, not running an action: Select or Combobox.

keyboard.action: Moves from the main action to the arrow that opens the menu.
On the main side, runs the action. On the arrow, opens the menu.
Moves between the options of the open menu.
Goes to the first or last option.
Closes the menu and returns focus to the arrow.

props.description: Option run initially by the main button. Default: first enabled.

import { SplitButton } from '@refy-design/web';
import type { ComponentProps } from 'react';
const Download = (
  <svg
    viewBox="0 0 24 24"
    fill="none"
    stroke="currentColor"
    strokeWidth={1.8}
    strokeLinecap="round"
    strokeLinejoin="round"
  >
    <path d="M21 15v4a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2v-4" />
    <polyline points="7 10 12 15 17 10" />
    <line x1="12" y1="15" x2="12" y2="3" />
  </svg>
);
const exportOptions = [
  { id: 'pdf', label: 'PDF', hint: '.pdf' },
  { id: 'csv', label: 'CSV', hint: '.csv' },
  { id: 'markdown', label: 'Markdown', hint: '.md' },
  { id: 'json', label: 'JSON', hint: '.json' },
];
export function Example() {
  const args: Pick<
    ComponentProps<typeof SplitButton>,
    | 'label'
    | 'defaultOptionId'
    | 'leadingIcon'
    | 'size'
    | 'variant'
    | 'menuAlign'
    | 'options'
    | 'loading'
    | 'loadingLabel'
  > = {
    label: 'Export',
    defaultOptionId: 'pdf',
    leadingIcon: Download,
    size: 'md',
    variant: 'secondary',
    menuAlign: 'end',
    options: exportOptions,
    loading: true,
    loadingLabel: 'Exporting…',
  };
  return <SplitButton {...args} />;
}
